dataset_name: Study-area polygon supplied to the analysis

source.provider: Author-created boundary derived from IBRA 7.0 subregions
source.creation_method: One-feature study extent derived from the 162 selected IBRA7 subregions in inputs/data_raw/spatial_grids/ibra_selected.shp; the precise geometry operation was not recorded.
source.citation: Author-created study extent derived from Interim Biogeographic Regionalisation for Australia (IBRA) 7.0 subregions; cite the IBRA source alongside this derivative.
source.licence: Derivative of IBRA 7.0 data, which require attribution under CC BY 3.0 Australia.
source.redistribution_status: May be shared with attribution to the IBRA 7.0 source.

dbf_fields.name: OBJECTID
dbf_fields.definition: Feature identifier in the supplied boundary file.

dbf_fields.name: Shape_Leng
dbf_fields.definition: Stored geometry-length attribute from the source file; not used by the workflow.

dbf_fields.name: Shape_Area
dbf_fields.definition: Stored geometry-area attribute from the source file; not used by the workflow.

schema.workflow_use: Boundary for creating the hexagon grid and for cropping/masking the raw land-use and vegetation rasters.

provenance_limit: The exact subregion selection is preserved in ibra_selected.shp, but the original operation that combined those features into study_area.shp was not recorded.
